name: Bichon
description: Bichon is a self-hosted email archiver written in Rust. It downloads emails via IMAP, builds a full-text index, and provides a REST API with an integrated WebUI. It is not an email client — Bichon does not send emails, it only archives and searches them.

paths.name: Data Dir
paths.description: Bichon data directory (index, blob storage, metadata). Must be located on a local filesystem (not NFS/SMB).

ports.name: TCP - WebUI/REST API
ports.description: HTTP port for the WebUI / REST API

variables.name: Root Directory
variables.description: Required. Absolute path for all persistent data (inside the container).

variables.name: Encrypt Password
variables.description: Required. Password used to encrypt stored credentials (IMAP passwords, OAuth tokens). Be sure to replace this with a secure password!

variables.name: Log Level
variables.description: Log level: trace, debug, info, warn, error.

variables.name: Enable SMTP
variables.description: Enable the embedded SMTP receiver (receive only, no sending).

variables.name: Public URL
variables.description: Publicly reachable URL, used for OAuth redirects and documentation.
